name: scansci-pdf
description: Academic paper retrieval hub backed by the scansci-pdf MCP server: multi-route PDF download (open access, publisher API, institutional), batch queues, citation export, Zotero push, and environment diagnostics.

interface.shortDescription: Download papers, export citations, push to Zotero via the scansci-pdf MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Export citations and push them to Zotero
Run scansci-pdf diagnostics to check my setup
interface.longDescription: Bridges the open-source scansci-pdf MCP server into this skill marketplace: single or batch paper retrieval with tiered routing (open access, publisher API, institutional channels), citation export in BibTeX/RIS/EndNote, Zotero push, and one-command environment diagnostics.
